stop: The third Claude call (OpenSearch BEFORE) exceeded the preregistered 300-second limit; no retry, timeout increase, replacement, or imputation was performed.

scanner.candidate_limit: A candidate is not a semantic verdict; the scanner missed three strict targets and produced non-target candidates, including Chronograf #10f at the target line.

limitations: The 30-call three-model matrix is incomplete; the two completed Claude calls are not a host cohort and are excluded from paired outcomes.
The already completed Sol and Astra cohorts are descriptive subsets of this interrupted run, not a protocol PASS or general scanner effect.

Historical controls create a temporal/provider-state confound; repository CI also ran concurrently with this live run, so elapsed-time differences and the timeout must not be attributed solely to the scanner or model.
Five selected public clusters, one repetition, and source-level adjudication do not estimate population recall, precision, or release readiness.
Precomputed scanner evidence with model tools disabled is not the full interactive skill workflow; Tier 1 was disabled for project-code safety.
Additional-prediction counts repeat correlated case-side findings and must not be interpreted as independent defects.
